trace_timing_limit: Shared host/cgroup contention, different load/encode boundaries and checkpoint I/O. These are diagnostic run times, not clean benchmarks or evidence of a speedup.
known_cpu_work: umT5 relative-bias attention, normalization, RoPE, modulation/layout and depthwise convolution
Shared try_attention always computes full CPU attention for TODO-044 validation, even when the device output passes; it may additionally retry or return CPU values.
